import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(data['brand'].unique()))
brand_colors = dict(zip(data['brand'].unique(), colors))

# 1. Price vs Megapixels scatter plot
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
for brand in data['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = data[data['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
               label=brand, s=100, alpha=0.7, color=brand_colors[brand])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Weight vs Price scatter plot
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
for brand in data['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = data[data['brand'] == brand]
    ax2.scatter(brand_data['weight_grams'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
               label=brand, s=100, alpha=0.7, color=brand_colors[brand])
ax2.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Price vs Weight by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Max ISO by Brand (bar plot)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
brands_iso = data.groupby('brand')['max_iso'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax3.bar(range(len(brands_iso)), brands_iso.values, 
               color=[brand_colors[b] for b in brands_iso.index], alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(brands_iso)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(brands_iso.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Average Max ISO by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 4. Sensor Type distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sensor_counts = data['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax4.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette("Set3", len(sensor_counts)))
ax4.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Body Type distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
body_counts = data['body_type'].value_counts()
ax5.pie(body_counts.values, labels=body_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(body_counts)))
ax5.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 6. 4K Video capability
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
video_4k = data['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels = ['No 4K', '4K']
ax6.pie(video_4k.values, labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        startangle=90, colors=['#ff9999', '#66b3ff'])
ax6.set_title('4K Video Capability', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Model Year timeline with price
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
for brand in data['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = data[data['brand'] == brand]
    ax7.scatter(brand_data['model_year'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
               label=brand, s=brand_data['megapixels']*5, 
               alpha=0.6, color=brand_colors[brand])
ax7.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Price vs Model Year (bubble size = megapixels)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper left')
ax7.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Camera Specifications Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
